note: Substantive updates to the Atlas, most recent first. Each entry records a real verification or reclassification against primary sources.

updates.title: 2026-10-27 primary-source re-verification and citation corrections
updates.detail: Re-verified flagged entries against enrolled statutes, codified sections, and administering regulators. Corrected citation errors in Maine, Nebraska, and New Jersey; refined Florida, Iowa, Louisiana, Colorado, and Wisconsin. Confirmed New York's proposed 23 NYCRR Part 202 and New Mexico's Uniform Money Services Act coverage of virtual currency.

updates.title: Corrected statutory chapter: ch. 79-A, not ch. 80
updates.detail: The Maine Money Transmission Modernization Act is codified at 32 M.R.S. ch. 79-A, § 6067 et seq. (short title confirmed at § 6067), enacted by LD 2112 / PL 2023, c. 662. Chapter 80 is the separate Check Cashers / Virtual Currency Kiosks chapter. Fixed the chapter cite and added the PL session-law cite.

updates.title: Corrected Financial Innovation Act citation to §§ 8-3001 to 8-3031
updates.detail: The Nebraska Financial Innovation Act is Neb. Rev. Stat. §§ 8-3001 to 8-3031 (LB 649, 2021; § 8-3001 short title confirmed), not § 8-2724. Section 8-2724 is 'Authorized delegate; authorized; procedures' in the Money Transmitters Act. Relabeled the NFIA cite and the depository-exemption reference; kept § 8-2715 as the money-transmission/virtual-currency cite.

updates.title: Corrected pending digital-asset bill: A2249, not A3454
updates.detail: The Digital Asset and Blockchain Technology Act is A2249 (2024-2025 session), companion S1304 (prior-session A2371/S1756), confirmed pending on the NJ Legislature site. A3454 in this session is an unrelated 'Entrepreneur Learner's Permit Pilot Program' bill. Corrected the bill number.

updates.title: Added chapter-law and codified-section cites
updates.detail: Confirmed against the codified statute: the Payment Stablecoin Act is Ch. 2026-176, codified at Fla. Stat. §§ 560.501-560.504 (§ 560.504 ties one-to-one reserve requirements to the GENIUS Act, Pub. L. 119-27). The stablecoin provisions are effective Oct. 1, 2026 (the act's general effective date is June 26, 2026).

updates.title: Corrected act name to Uniform Money Transmission Modernization Act
updates.detail: Iowa Code § 533C.101 states the chapter 'may be cited as the Uniform Money Transmission Modernization Act.' Corrected from 'Uniform Money Services Act.'

updates.title: Added original enactment: Act 341 of 2020
updates.detail: Act 341 of 2020 enacted Chapter 21 of Title 6 (R.S. 6:1381 through 1394), the Virtual Currency Businesses Act, later amended by SB 185 / Act 331 (2023). Added the original enactment and the Title 6 chapter reference.

updates.title: Corrected short title to Model Money Transmission Modernization Act
updates.detail: HB 25-1201's official title is the 'Model Money Transmission Modernization Act' (Governor signed Apr. 18, 2025). Added 'Model' and the signing date.

updates.title: Corrected short title to Model Money Transmission Modernization Law
updates.detail: Wis. Stat. § 217.01 states the chapter's short title is the 'Model Money Transmission Modernization Law' (2023 Wisconsin Act 267). Corrected from 'Money Transmission Modernization Act.'

updates.title: Full primary-source verification pass complete
updates.detail: Every state and DC verified against enrolled statutes and regulator guidance, with a pincite recorded for each: bill number, public act, and codified citation. Secondary sources removed.

updates.title: Reclassified to a live licensing regime
updates.detail: Verified against HB 1272. Georgia moved to Live, with a two-tier detail covering transmission licensing and its emerging issuer pathway.

updates.title: Verified against DACPA, DAKA and SB 3412; Digital Asset Tax Act added
updates.detail: Confirmed the Digital Assets and Consumer Protection Act (Public Act 104-0428) reaches stablecoins under Section (4)(B), added the kiosk caps in the Digital Asset Kiosk Act, and recorded the SB 3412 money-transmission changes.

updates.title: Added HB 701 (2025) blockchain carve-outs
updates.detail: Recorded the digital-asset carve-outs at KRS 286.11-007(8) and KRS chapter 369.

updates.title: Updated to 2023 Act 267 (new MTMA)
updates.detail: Money transmission now sits under Wis. Stat. ch. 217. The DFI interpretation keeps virtual-currency transmission outside licensing, so Wisconsin stays VC Excluded.

updates.title: Regulator named for every jurisdiction
updates.detail: Each state card now identifies the specific agency that administers money-transmission and virtual-currency licensing.

updates.title: Consistent summary and issuer checklist added
updates.detail: Every entry now carries a plain-language summary and a 'What issuers must do' key-points layer.

updates.title: Stable Token Act primary-sourced
updates.detail: Verified the Wyoming Stable Token Act (SF0127 / Enrolled Act 85, W.S. 40-31-101 to 109) and the digital-asset taxonomy at W.S. 34-29-101 that anchors the virtual-currency exemption.

updates.title: Reconciled to HB 3521 enrolled text
updates.detail: Corrected the current-law citation to the Financial Transaction Reporting Act (6 O.S. 1511 et seq.) and added kiosk rules from 6 O.S. 1520.1.

updates.title: Current and incoming law separated
updates.detail: Split the current two-party-exemption regime (ch. 560) from the incoming HB 175 issuer license.

updates.title: Treasury Section 3 NPRM added; GENIUS effective date noted
updates.detail: Added the Section 3 prohibitions NPRM and the expected GENIUS Act effective date of January 18, 2027.

updates.title: Current DFS regime clarified
updates.detail: Confirmed the 2022 DFS guidance as the current regime, with proposed Part 202 as its successor.
